quotes.text: Cathedral church, originally of Benedictine Priory, refounded 1541 as secular cathedral.
quotes.page: Official list entry, Details, opening line

quotes.text: Main body 1093-1130, begun by Bishop William of St. Calais; Galilee 1189 for Bishop le Puiset. West tower tops, east bay and Chapel of nine altars, 1242-c.1280. 1464-88 tower top stage. Restorations of late C18, early C19 and mid C19, notably by Bonomi and Jackson, Pickering and Robson and Fowler. Dressed sandstone; slate roofs. Cruciform with aisles, east transept aisles, transeptal eastern chapel, crossing tower, twin west towers and western Galilee.
quotes.page: Official list entry, Details, following the opening line

quotes.text: INTERIOR: tall 7-bay nave has alternating compound and incised round piers. Intersecting blank arcading to ground stage with single lights above; paired arches to gallery bays, three stepped arches in clerestory. Rib-vaulted throughout, many ribs enriched.
quotes.page: Official list entry, Details, INTERIOR paragraph

quotes.text: Galilee: five aisles of even width, four bays; quatrefoil piers with waterleaf capitals and rich chevron mouldings to arches and vault ribs.
quotes.page: Official list entry, Details, INTERIOR paragraph, following the nave description

quotes.text: Eastern transept nine bays wide, divided into three and then into single bays by large buttresses.
quotes.page: Official list entry, Details, exterior description

note: Tranche 3, English medieval fabric and the Tudor house, 5 Sep 2026. The exemplar names the NAVE and this record is the cathedral that contains it -- `oq/an-exemplar-that-is-not-one-whole-building`; Historic England lists the whole church as one entry. The node's exemplar note says plainly that this building is not domestic, and the record is kept for the reason the note gives. THE ENTRY DOES NOT SAY THE HIGH VAULT IS THE FIRST OF ITS KIND IN EUROPE -- it says only 'Rib-vaulted throughout, many ribs enriched' -- so the exemplar's `why` does not repeat that claim. Extracted twice with different queries; the second returned the Details header the first had not.
